name: Advanced Fiber Resources (Zhuhai), Ltd.
summary: Advanced Fiber Resources (Zhuhai), Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells passive optical components and modulators in China and internationally. The company offers optical isolators and combiners, couplers/splitters, modulators, optical circulators and collimators, filters, in-line polarizers, FBG, photodiodes, isolator hybrid products, PBS/PBC, VOA, metalized fibers, faraday mirrors, Patchcord, optical delay lines, active devices packaging products, module, MEMS, laser cables, and other products.
